sources.name: City of Toronto Pedestrian Network
sources.licence_name: Open Government Licence – Toronto
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto.
sources.tier_note: Municipal open data is tier 0. It is not shown as verified.
sources.notes: CKAN package pedestrian-network, license_id open-government-licence-toronto, last refreshed 2026-02-20. The file has 87,105 segments. Only segments where the publisher states a place to walk are imported: a sidewalk on both sides or on a named side, a City walkway, a recreational trail, or a Walkway, Trail or Pathway road type. Segments published with no sidewalk, a partial sidewalk, a laneway without a sidewalk, a roadway under development, or no description on a road are left out, because the line is the roadway. ROAD_TYPE is stored as kind, the sidewalk description as footway, the crosswalk type code as crossing and LENGTH (metres per the publisher readme) as length_m. The readme does not define the crosswalk type codes, so they are stored unchanged. The file has no surface, width, slope or curb column, so those fields are UNKNOWN. The line is the publisher's network line. It is not a surveyed sidewalk edge.
